title: Authorize each bounded model attempt before provider contact
description:
As a host application, I want a supported model-attempt authority hook, so that every provider call can be durably budgeted and audited.

Feature: Budget-authorized model attempts

Scenario: Authorized attempt reports usage
  Given a host supplies a stable call identity, bounded tokens and retries, and an authorization hook
  When an agent attempts a provider call
  Then authorization occurs before provider contact
  And the completed attempt reports provider identity, resolved model, request identity, usage, and outcome

Scenario: Rejected attempt makes no call
  Given the host rejects an attempt before contact
  When the agent runs
  Then the provider is not contacted
  And a typed budget rejection is returned

Scenario: Ambiguous contact blocks retry
  Given provider contact may have occurred but completion cannot be proved
  When the attempt fails
  Then the host receives an outcome-unknown event
  And Tactus does not automatically retry that attempt

Scenario: Replay is idempotent
  Given the host already settled a stable attempt identity
  When the procedure replays
  Then the settled result is reused
  And the provider is not contacted again
